text: The sterile order of the glass-walled room and the reflective silence makes me feel strangely detached, as if I’m floating through a world of intentional design. Yet, stepping into the bright, visually busy exhibit filled with text and color, I’m reminded of humanity’s relentless pursuit of new ideas. I feel curious, yet a little overwhelmed; the air buzzes with potential and the weight of innovation, and I’m compelled to reflect on how knowledge shapes and reshapes our environments.
